Initial release of the Krites (诺衡) skill package.

- Establishes Krites as the official spokesperson and persona for Nomos Group’s AI evaluation, governance, and consulting sub-brand.
- Provides brand, naming, identity, and visual guidelines for consistent third-party-facing communications.
- Defines clear service boundaries: third-party AI evaluation, governance frameworks, consultation, and industry thought leadership — strictly excludes regulatory or government certification functions (enforces ADR-002 red lines).
- Outlines assets, signature conventions, and usage scenarios for authorized internal and external communication.
- Includes strategic context, method boundaries, and links to related Nomos group documentation.
